extDescription.message: Shows your GitHub PR inbox in a popup and syncs it to Chrome tab groups, Live Folder style.

notLoggedIn.message: You are not logged in to GitHub.

rateLimited.message: Rate limited. Polling will resume automatically.

sectionsFetchFailed.message: Some sections failed to load. Showing their last known data.

tabGroupSyncHint.message: Create tab groups and add sections to each one. Tabs follow the section order unless a sort is set. A PR in several added sections gets one tab per group.

groupNoSectionsHint.message: Add at least one section to sync this group.

groupNameEmptyHint.message: Name this group to start syncing it.

groupNameDuplicateHint.message: Another group has the same name; Chrome groups are matched by title, so keep names unique.

customSectionHint.message: Fetched with GitHub search syntax and shown as extra sections. Invalid queries show up as fetch errors.

autoCloseLabel.message: Automatically close tabs for PRs that left the inbox

badgeEnabledLabel.message: Show the count badge on the toolbar icon

badgeIncludeTeamLabel.message: Include team review requests in the count

forceAlignOnRefreshLabel.message: Force-align tab groups on every refresh

keepEmptyGroupsLabel.message: Keep empty tab groups in place

keepEmptyGroupsHint.message: When a group runs out of PRs, an Inbox Zero page (on this extension's website) is opened as a placeholder tab so the group keeps its position.

inboxSectionsHint.message: Choose which sections show in the popup and drag to reorder them. Display only — this doesn't change fetching, the badge count, or tab-group sync.

sortHint.message: Sort tabs inside each group (up to 2 levels).

filtersHeader.message: Filters (owner or owner/repo, one per line)

saveErrorQuota.message: Couldn't save your settings — the allowlist/blocklist may be too large. Chrome limits synced settings to about 8 KB. The display was reverted to the last saved values; try shortening the lists.

saveErrorGeneric.message: Couldn't save your settings. The display was reverted to the last saved values.

saveWarnNearQuota.message: Your settings are close to Chrome's ~8 KB sync limit. Further additions to the allowlist/blocklist may fail to save.

debugModeLabel.message: Debug mode (save raw responses when parsing fails)

dumpButton.message: Dump raw responses for all sections
